name: list-pull-requests
description: Lists the pull requests of a GitHub repository, open by default, with each one's number (which github__get-pull-request takes), branches, labels, requested reviewers, dates and link. The repository's owner and name come from github__list-my-repositories.

owner.description: The repository's owner, the part before the slash of a full_name github__list-my-repositories answers.

repo.description: The repository's name, the part after the slash of a full_name github__list-my-repositories answers.

state.description: Which pull requests to list: open, closed or all.

sort.description: Sort by created, updated, popularity or long-running.

perPage.description: How many pull requests per page, at most 100.
